people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
translations.bsb: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
translations.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
translations.asv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
